title: Omara Ventures India IPO Details
intro:
Omara Ventures India IPO is a book build issue of ₹41.99 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 13.50 lakh shares of ₹41.99 crore.

Omara Ventures India IPO opens for subscription on Sep 30, 2026 and closes on Oct 5, 2026. The allotment for the Omara Ventures India IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 6, 2026. Omara Ventures India IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 8, 2026.

Omara Ventures India IPO is set issue price band at ₹296 to ₹311 per share. The lot size for an application is 400 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,48,800 (800 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (1,200 shares), amounting to ₹3,73,200.

Wealth Mine Networks Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Rikhav Securities Ltd.

Refer to Omara Ventures India IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in October 2020, Omara Ventures India Limited is a retail jewellery company engaged in the sale of diamond jewellery made using natural diamonds and precious and semi-precious gemstones, set in precious metals such as gold, platinum and silver. The Company operates under the brand name “Omara” and primarily caters to business-to-consumer (B2C) customers through its retail boutique.The Company offers a curated portfolio of diamond jewellery comprising necklaces, earrings, rings, bracelets and other jewellery products, catering to different customer preferences, age groups and occasions. Its offerings include wedding jewellery, special occasion jewellery, festive jewellery and contemporary daily-wear jewellery, across various price points. The Company focuses on combining traditional elegance with contemporary aesthetics through design-led and curated collections.

The Company’s business model is centred around in-house product conceptualisation, design development, customer preference analysis, product curation and retail merchandising. It has entered into a product development and supply arrangement with a product development and supply partner for manufacturing and supplying jewellery based on the Company’s approved designs, specifications and quality standards. The Company also provides customisation services, enabling customers to personalise jewellery based on their individual preferences and occasions.

Omara follows a curated product philosophy, with collections comprising select designs developed in limited quantities to maintain exclusivity and design distinctiveness. The “Omara” logo or brand insignia is embossed or marked on each jewellery product sold by the Company, supporting brand visibility and product authenticity. Its jewellery is supported by applicable quality certifications, including BIS hallmarking for precious metals and diamond grading or certification from recognised gemological laboratories such as GIA, wherever applicable.
As on June 30, 2026, the Company had 17 employees across directors, KMP and senior management, accounts, sales and marketing, product and operations, sales and operational support functions.
strengths: Established retail boutique and operational infrastructure.
Emphasis on quality, certification and product authenticity.
Brand visibility through selective marketing and logo embossing.
Focus on in-house product conceptualisation and design development.

The Company also provides customisation services, enabling customers to personalise jewellery based on their individual preferences and occasions.

Omara follows a curated product philosophy, with collections comprising select designs developed in limited quantities to maintain exclusivity and design distinctiveness. objectives: 1 — Funding capital expenditure requirements towards Renovation and Expansion of the Jewellery Boutique
2 — Marketing and promotional expenses aimed at enhancing local brand awareness and visibility of the flagship brand, “OMARA”

4 — Funding the long-term working capital requirements of the Company

faqs.question: How to apply in Omara Ventures India IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Omara Ventures India IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Omara Ventures India IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Omara Ventures India IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Omara Ventures India IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: How to apply for Omara Ventures India IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Omara Ventures India IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .
